name: Green Lake County, WI
findings: Green Lake County has 92 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Green Lake County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 1 in similar places of this size.
